# Bob’s Discount Furniture Earns Dual Newsweek Honors for Customer Service and Online Shopping Experience


November 09, 2026 10:00am EST


*Recognition underscores the retailer’s commitment to a seamless omnichannel shopping experience*


MANCHESTER, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Bob’s Discount Furniture, one of the nation’s fastest-growing omnichannel furniture retailers, today announced that it has been named to Newsweek’s America’s Best Customer Service and America’s Best Online Shops lists. Together, the honors recognize two essential parts of the Bob’s experience: the dedicated team members who support customers and the technology that makes shopping simple, convenient and connected.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261109713231/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261109713231/en/)


The dual recognition reflects Bob’s approach to meeting customers wherever and however they choose to shop. Whether a customer begins online, visits a showroom or moves between channels, Bob’s aims to provide the same welcoming service, transparent value and easy experience at every step.


**Two Honors, One Connected Customer Experience**


Newsweek’s America’s Best Customer Service recognition is based on customer evaluations of service experiences, including factors such as communication, professional competence, range of services, customer focus and accessibility. The recognition highlights the human side of Bob’s business—from knowledgeable showroom teams to customer-care associates who help customers navigate their purchases.


Newsweek’s America’s Best Online Shops recognition evaluates leading e-commerce destinations across criteria that include trust and security, purchase and delivery, website structure and usability, service and communication, technical performance, payment options, likelihood of purchase and traffic growth. Bob’s inclusion reflects the company’s continued focus on creating a reliable and intuitive digital shopping experience.


“These honors are especially meaningful because they recognize both sides of the experience we work to deliver every day: innovative technology that makes shopping easier and caring team members who make it personal,” said Bill Barton, President and Chief Executive Officer of Bob’s Discount Furniture. “Our customers do not think in channels—they simply expect Bob’s to be there for them. We are proud of our teams for creating a connected experience that brings together great value, helpful service and convenience, whether a customer shops online, in a showroom or both.”


Bob’s omnichannel strategy connects online shopping with the in-store experience, giving customers flexibility as they browse, compare, plan and purchase furniture for their homes. The two Newsweek honors reinforce the company’s commitment to investing in both technology and people so every interaction feels unmistakably Bob’s.


**About Bob’s Discount Furniture**


Bob’s Discount Furniture is a high-growth, national omnichannel retailer of value home furnishings with more than 225 showrooms across the United States. Since our founding in 1991, we have built our ethos as a trusted and reliable brand offering superior value and service, without compromising on quality or style. Our business model is anchored in delivering furniture at “Everyday Low Prices,” and at the heart of Bob’s success is not just the value of our furniture, but the team members who bring our promise to life every day. From showroom to living room, it’s our people who make Bob’s feel like home. Our belief that everyone deserves a home they love is reflected in how we operate daily and the appreciation we have for our people and communities. From our in-store guest experience specialists who create a no-pressure, no-gimmicks shopping experience, to our distribution and logistics teams who enable fast, reliable fulfillment, Bob’s is built on the dedication of more than 5,800 team members nationwide.
